items.source: Simple interface allowing Spring-managed MBeans to publish JMX notifications without being aware of how those notifications are being transmitted to the MBeanServer.
items.translation: 简单的接口，允许 Spring 管理的 MBeans 发布 JMX 通知，而无需了解这些通知是如何传输到 MBeanServer 的。

items.source: Thrown when a JMX Notification is unable to be sent.
items.translation: 当 JMX Notification 无法发送时抛出。

items.source:
Provides supporting infrastructure to allow Spring-created MBeans
to send JMX notifications.
items.translation: 提供支持基础设施，允许 Spring 创建的 MBean 发送 JMX 通知。
